140: static bool wifi_cp_range(uint32_t address, size_t length)
141: {
142:   return address >= BK7258_CP_RAM_START &&
143:          address <= BK7258_CP_RAM_END &&
144:          length <= (size_t)(BK7258_CP_RAM_END - address);
145: }
146: 
147: static bool wifi_cp_pointer(uint32_t address, size_t length)
148: {
149:   return (address & 3u) == 0 && wifi_cp_range(address, length);
150: }

152: static int wifi_send_node(uint8_t mailbox_channel, uint8_t node_channel,
153:                           uint32_t head, uint32_t tail, uint8_t count)
154: {
155:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
156:   struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node node;
157: 
158:   memset(&node, 0, sizeof(node));
159:   node.head = head;
160:   node.tail = tail;
161:   node.channel = node_channel;
162:   node.num = count;
163:   memcpy(&message, &node, sizeof(message));
164:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
165:   return bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(mailbox_channel, &message, NULL, NULL);
166: }

179: static struct wifi_command_slot *wifi_command_alloc(void)
180: {
181:   unsigned int i;
182: 
183:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
184:     {
185:       uint32_t *pattern = (uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes;
186: 
187:       if (!g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
188:           *pattern == BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE)
189:         {
190:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = true;
191:           *pattern = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_BUSY;
192:           return &g_wifi.command[i];
193:         }
194:     }
195: 
196:   return NULL;
197: }
198: 
199: static void wifi_command_reap(void)
200: {
201:   unsigned int i;
202: 
203:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
204:     {
205:       uint32_t pattern = *(uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes;
206: 
207:       if (g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
208:           pattern == BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE)
209:         {
210:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = false;
211:         }
212:     }
213: }

215: static int wifi_command(uint16_t command, const void *payload,
216:                          uint16_t payload_length, void *result,
217:                          uint16_t result_size, uint16_t *result_length)
218: {
219:   struct wifi_command_slot *slot;
220:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;
221:   struct bk7258_wifi_msg_hdr *header;
222:   uint16_t sequence;
223:   int ret;
224: 
225:   if (payload_length > BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOT_SIZE - sizeof(uint32_t) -
226:                        sizeof(*cpdu) - sizeof(*header))
227:     {
228:       return -E2BIG;
229:     }
230: 
231:   if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
232:     {
233:       return -ENOLINK;
234:     }
235: 
236:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
237:   wifi_command_reap();
238:   slot = wifi_command_alloc();
239:   if (slot == NULL)
240:     {
241:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
242:       return -ENOMEM;
243:     }
244: 
245:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(slot->bytes + sizeof(uint32_t));
246:   header = (struct bk7258_wifi_msg_hdr *)(cpdu + 1);
247:   sequence = ++g_wifi.next_sequence;
248:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu) + sizeof(*header) + payload_length);
249:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + sizeof(*header) + payload_length;
250:   header->cmd_id = command;
251:   header->cmd_sn = sequence;
252:   header->length = payload_length;
253:   if (payload != NULL && payload_length != 0)
254:     {
255:       memcpy(header + 1, payload, payload_length);
256:     }
257: 
258:   while (nxsem_trywait(&g_wifi.command_sem) == OK)
259:     {
260:     }
261: 
262:   {
263:     irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
264: 
265:     g_wifi.waiting_id = command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET;
266:     g_wifi.waiting_sequence = sequence;
267:     g_wifi.command_result = -ETIMEDOUT;
268:     g_wifi.command_length = 0;
269:     up_irq_restore(flags);
270:   }
271:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_TX_CHANNEL, 0,
272:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
273:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1);
274:   if (ret < 0)
275:     {
276:       *(uint32_t *)slot->bytes = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
277:       slot->owned = false;
278:       {
279:         irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
280: 
281:         if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
282:             g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
283:           {
284:             g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
285:           }
286:         up_irq_restore(flags);
287:       }
288:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
289:       return ret;
290:     }
291: 
292:   ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.command_sem,
293:                                        WIFI_COMMAND_TIMEOUT);
294:   {
295:     irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
296: 
297:     if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
298:         g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
299:       {
300:         g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
301:       }
302:     if (ret >= 0)
303:       {
304:         ret = g_wifi.command_result;
305:       }
306:     up_irq_restore(flags);
307:   }
308: 
309:   if (ret >= 0 && result != NULL && result_size != 0)
310:     {
311:       uint16_t copy = g_wifi.command_length < result_size ?
312:                       g_wifi.command_length : result_size;
313:       memcpy(result, g_wifi.command_data, copy);
314:     }
315:   if (ret >= 0 && result_length != NULL)
316:     {
317:       *result_length = g_wifi.command_length;
318:     }
319: 
320:   wifi_command_reap();
321:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
322:   return ret;
323: }

325: static void wifi_set_carrier(bool carrier)
326: {
327:   if (carrier != g_wifi.carrier)
328:     {
329:       g_wifi.carrier = carrier;
330:       if (g_wifi.initialized && carrier)
331:         {

333:         }

335:         {
336:           netdev_lower_carrier_off(&g_wifi.lower);

341: static void wifi_scan_cache_clear(void)
342: {
343:   kmm_free(g_wifi.scan_cache);
344:   g_wifi.scan_cache = NULL;
345:   g_wifi.scan_cache_length = 0;
346:   g_wifi.scan_cached = false;
347: }

349: static int wifi_scan_cache_append(const void *data, size_t length)
350: {
351:   if (length > WIFI_SCAN_CACHE_LIMIT - g_wifi.scan_cache_length)
352:     {
353:       return -E2BIG;
354:     }
355: 
356:   memcpy(g_wifi.scan_cache + g_wifi.scan_cache_length, data, length);
357:   g_wifi.scan_cache_length += length;
358:   return OK;
359: }

361: static int wifi_scan_cache_event(uint16_t command, const void *data,
362:                                  size_t length)
363: {
364:   struct iw_event event;
365: 
366:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
367:   event.cmd = command;
368:   event.len = offsetof(struct iw_event, u) + length;
369:   if (length > sizeof(event.u))
370:     {
371:       return -E2BIG;
372:     }
373:   memcpy(&event.u, data, length);
374:   return wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
375: }

377: static int wifi_scan_cache_build_record(
378:   const struct bk7258_wifi_scan_record *record)
379: {
380:   struct iw_event event;
381:   struct iw_quality quality;
382:   struct iw_freq frequency;
383:   uint16_t flags;
384:   size_t ssid_length;
385:   size_t padded_length;
386:   size_t event_length;
387:   int ret;
388: 
389:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
390:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWAP;
391:   event.len = IW_EV_LEN(ap_addr);
392:   event.u.ap_addr.sa_family = ARPHRD_ETHER;
393:   memcpy(event.u.ap_addr.sa_data, record->bssid, sizeof(record->bssid));
394:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
395:   if (ret < 0)
396:     {
397:       return ret;
398:     }
399: 
400:   ssid_length = strnlen(record->ssid, sizeof(record->ssid));
401:   padded_length = (ssid_length + 3u) & ~3u;
402:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
403:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWESSID;
404:   event.u.essid.flags = IW_ESSID_ON;
405:   event.u.essid.length = ssid_length;
406:   event.u.essid.pointer = (void *)(uintptr_t)sizeof(struct iw_point);
407:   event_length = offsetof(struct iw_event, u) + sizeof(struct iw_point) +
408:                  padded_length;
409:   event.len = event_length;
410:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, offsetof(struct iw_event, u) +
411:                                sizeof(struct iw_point));
412:   if (ret < 0)
413:     {
414:       return ret;
415:     }
416:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(record->ssid, ssid_length);
417:   if (ret < 0)
418:     {
419:       return ret;
420:     }
421:   if (padded_length != ssid_length)
422:     {
423:       uint32_t padding = 0;
424:       ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&padding, padded_length - ssid_length);
425:       if (ret < 0)
426:         {
427:           return ret;
428:         }
429:     }
430: 
431:   memset(&quality, 0, sizeof(quality));
432:   quality.level = (uint8_t)record->rssi;
433:   quality.updated = IW_QUAL_DBM;
434:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_event(IWEVQUAL, &quality, sizeof(quality));
435:   if (ret < 0)
436:     {
437:       return ret;
438:     }
439: 
440:   memset(&frequency, 0, sizeof(frequency));
441:   frequency.m = record->channel;
442:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_event(SIOCGIWFREQ, &frequency, sizeof(frequency));
443:   if (ret < 0)
444:     {
445:       return ret;
446:     }
447: 
448:   flags = record->security == 0 ? IW_ENCODE_DISABLED : IW_ENCODE_ENABLED;
449:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
450:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWENCODE;
451:   event.len = IW_EV_LEN(data);
452:   event.u.data.flags = flags;
453:   return wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
454: }

456: static int wifi_scan_cache_fetch(void)
457: {
458:   struct bk7258_wifi_scan_page_request request;
459:   struct bk7258_wifi_scan_page_response response;
460:   uint16_t start = 0;
461:   uint16_t total = 0;
462:   uint16_t result_length;
463:   int ret;
464: 
465:   g_wifi.scan_cache = kmm_malloc(WIFI_SCAN_CACHE_LIMIT);
466:   if (g_wifi.scan_cache == NULL)
467:     {
468:       return -ENOMEM;
469:     }
470: 
471:   do
472:     {
473:       memset(&request, 0, sizeof(request));
474:       request.start = start;
475:       request.max_records = BK7258_WIFI_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS;
476:       memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
477:       ret = wifi_command(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_OPENVELA_SCAN_PAGE,
478:                          &request, sizeof(request), &response,
479:                          sizeof(response), &result_length);
480:       if (ret < 0)
481:         {
482:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
483:           return ret;
484:         }
485:       if (result_length != sizeof(response) || response.status != 0 ||
486:           response.page.start != start ||
487:           response.page.count > BK7258_WIFI_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS ||
488:           response.page.reserved != 0 ||
489:           response.page.total < start ||
490:           response.page.count > response.page.total - start)
491:         {
492:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
493:           return response.status != 0 ? response.status : -EPROTO;
494:         }
495: 
496:       if (start == 0)
497:         {
498:           total = response.page.total;
499:         }
500:       else if (response.page.total != total)
501:         {
502:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
503:           return -EPROTO;
504:         }
505: 
506:       for (uint8_t i = 0; i < response.page.count; i++)
507:         {
508:           ret = wifi_scan_cache_build_record(&response.page.records[i]);
509:           if (ret < 0)
510:             {
511:               wifi_scan_cache_clear();
512:               return ret;
513:             }
514:         }
515: 
516:       start += response.page.count;
517:       if (response.page.more != (start < total) ||
518:           (response.page.count == 0 && start < total))
519:         {
520:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
521:           return -EPROTO;
522:         }
523:     }
524:   while (start < total);
525: 
526:   g_wifi.scan_cached = true;
527:   return OK;
528: }

530: static void wifi_release_cp_command(uint32_t cpdu_address)
531: {
532:   uint32_t pattern_address = cpdu_address - sizeof(uint32_t);
533: 
534:   if (wifi_cp_pointer(pattern_address, sizeof(uint32_t)))
535:     {
536:       *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)pattern_address =
537:         BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
538:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
539:     }
540: }

542: static void wifi_handle_command(uint32_t cpdu_address,
543:                                 uint32_t generation)
544: {
545:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
546:   struct bk7258_wifi_event_hdr event;
547:   uint32_t event_address;
548:   uint16_t length;
549: 
550:   if (!wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)))
551:     {
552:       return;
553:     }
554: 
555:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
556:   event_address = cpdu_address + sizeof(cpdu);
557:   if (cpdu.length < sizeof(cpdu) + sizeof(event) ||
558:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address, sizeof(event)))
559:     {
560:       return;
561:     }
562: 
563:   memcpy(&event, (const void *)(uintptr_t)event_address, sizeof(event));
564:   length = event.length;
565:   if (length > cpdu.length - sizeof(cpdu) - sizeof(event) ||
566:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address + WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET, length))
567:     {
568:       return;
569:     }
570: 
571:   if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
572:     {
573:       return;
574:     }
575: 
576:   if (event.id >= BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET)
577:     {
578:       irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
579: 
580:       if (event.id == g_wifi.waiting_id &&
581:           event.sequence == g_wifi.waiting_sequence)
582:         {
583:           if (length > sizeof(g_wifi.command_data))
584:             {
585:               length = sizeof(g_wifi.command_data);
586:             }
587:           if (length != 0)
588:             {
589:               memcpy(g_wifi.command_data,
590:                      (const void *)(uintptr_t)(event_address +
591:                                                WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET),
592:                      length);
593:             }
594:           g_wifi.command_length = length;
595:           g_wifi.command_result = OK;
596:           g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
597:           up_irq_restore(flags);
598:           nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
599:         }
600:       else
601:         {
602:           up_irq_restore(flags);
603:         }
604:     }
605:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_IPV4_IND)
606:     {
607:       wifi_set_carrier(true);
608:     }
609:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_WIFI_EVENT_IND && length >= 4)
610:     {
611:       uint16_t event_id;
612: 
613:       memcpy(&event_id,
614:              (const void *)(uintptr_t)(event_address +
615:                                        WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET),
616:              sizeof(event_id));
617:       if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_CONNECTED)
618:         {
619:           wifi_set_carrier(true);
620:         }
621:       else if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_DISCONNECTED)
622:         {
623:           wifi_set_carrier(false);
624:         }
625:     }
626:   else if (event.id == 3u)
627:     {
628:       wifi_set_carrier(false);
629:     }
630:   else if (event.id == 8u)
631:     {
632:       g_wifi.scan_running = false;
633:     }
634: 
635:   {
636:     irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
637: 
638:     if (generation == bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
639:       {
640:         wifi_release_cp_command(cpdu_address);
641:       }
642:     up_irq_restore(flags);
643:   }
644: }

646: static bool wifi_validate_command(uint32_t cpdu_address,
647:                                   uint32_t *next)
648: {
649:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
650:   struct bk7258_wifi_event_hdr event;
651:   uint32_t event_address;
652: 
653:   if (!wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)))
654:     {
655:       return false;
656:     }
657: 
658:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
659:   event_address = cpdu_address + sizeof(cpdu);
660:   if (cpdu.length < sizeof(cpdu) + sizeof(event) ||
661:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address, sizeof(event)))
662:     {
663:       return false;
664:     }
665: 
666:   memcpy(&event, (const void *)(uintptr_t)event_address, sizeof(event));
667:   if (event.length > cpdu.length - sizeof(cpdu) - sizeof(event) ||
668:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address + WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET, event.length))
669:     {
670:       return false;
671:     }
672: 
673:   *next = cpdu.next;
674:   return true;
675: }

677: static void wifi_handle_command_list(const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node,
678:                                      uint32_t generation)
679: {
680:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
681:   uint32_t address = node->head;
682:   unsigned int count;
683: 
684:   if (node->channel != 0 || node->num == 0 ||
685:       node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
686:     {
687:       return;
688:     }
689: 
690:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
691:     {
692:       uint32_t next;
693:       unsigned int previous;
694: 
695:       if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
696:           !wifi_validate_command(address, &next))
697:         {
698:           return;
699:         }
700:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
701:         {
702:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
703:             {
704:               return;
705:             }
706:         }
707:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
708:         {
709:           return;
710:         }
711: 
712:       addresses[count] = address;
713:       address = next;
714:     }
715: 
716:   if (address != 0)
717:     {
718:       return;
719:     }
720: 
721:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
722:     {
723:       if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
724:         {
725:           return;
726:         }
727: 
728:       wifi_handle_command(addresses[count], generation);
729:     }
730: }

732: static struct wifi_tx_slot *wifi_tx_slot(uint32_t cpdu_address)
733: {
734:   unsigned int i;
735: 
736:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_BK7258_WIFI_TX_SLOTS; i++)
737:     {
738:       struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu =
739:         (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)g_wifi.tx[i].headroom;
740: 
741:       if (cpdu_address == (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu)
742:         {
743:           return &g_wifi.tx[i];
744:         }
745:     }
746: 
747:   return NULL;

750: static bool wifi_copy_rx_frame(uint32_t cpdu_address,
751:                                struct wifi_rx_packet *packet)
752: {
753:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
754:   struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf pbuf;
755:   uint32_t pbuf_address;
756: 
757:   if (!wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)) ||
758:       cpdu_address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START + sizeof(pbuf))
759:     {
760:       return false;
761:     }
762: 
763:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
764:   pbuf_address = cpdu_address - sizeof(pbuf);
765:   if (!wifi_cp_pointer(pbuf_address, sizeof(pbuf)))
766:     {
767:       return false;
768:     }
769: 
770:   memcpy(&pbuf, (const void *)(uintptr_t)pbuf_address, sizeof(pbuf));
771:   if ((cpdu.flags & 1u) != 0 || pbuf.next != 0 || pbuf.len == 0 ||
772:       pbuf.len > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_FRAME || pbuf.tot_len != pbuf.len ||
773:       pbuf.ref == 0 || pbuf.ref == UINT8_MAX ||
774:       !wifi_cp_pointer(pbuf.payload, pbuf.len))
775:     {
776:       return false;
777:     }
778: 
779:   if (packet != NULL)
780:     {
781:       memcpy(packet->frame, (const void *)(uintptr_t)pbuf.payload, pbuf.len);
782:       packet->length = pbuf.len;
783:     }
784:   return true;
785: }

787: static void wifi_recycle_append(struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node,
788:                                 uint32_t cpdu_address)
789: {
790:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu =
791:     (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address;
792:   uint32_t pbuf_address;
793:   struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf *pbuf;
794: 
795:   pbuf_address = cpdu_address - sizeof(*pbuf);
796:   pbuf = (struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf *)(uintptr_t)pbuf_address;
797: 
798:   /* Match wdrv_txdata_sender(): CP drops one reference before pbuf_free(). */
799: 
800:   pbuf->ref++;
801:   cpdu->flags |= 1u;
802:   cpdu->next = 0;
803:   if (node->tail != 0)
804:     {
805:       ((struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(uintptr_t)node->tail)->next =
806:         cpdu_address;
807:     }
808:   else
809:     {
810:       node->head = cpdu_address;
811:     }
812: 
813:   node->tail = cpdu_address;
814:   node->num++;
815: }

817: static void wifi_recycle_complete(
818:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack, int result, void *arg)
819: {
820:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *entry = arg;
821:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
822: 
823:   (void)ack;
824:   if (entry->state == WIFI_RECYCLE_SENDING)
825:     {
826:       if (result == OK || entry->generation !=
827:           bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
828:         {
829:           entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
830:         }
831:       else
832:         {
833:           entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
834:         }
835:     }
836: 
837:   up_irq_restore(flags);
838:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
839: }

841: static void wifi_flush_recycle(void)
842: {
843:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *entry;
844:   irqstate_t flags;
845:   int ret;
846: 
847:   for (;;)
848:     {
849:       flags = up_irq_save();
850:       if (g_wifi.recycle_count == 0)
851:         {
852:           up_irq_restore(flags);
853:           return;
854:         }
855: 
856:       entry = &g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_head];
857:       if (entry->generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
858:         {
859:           entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
860:         }
861: 
862:       if (entry->state == WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD)
863:         {
864:           memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));
865:           g_wifi.recycle_head = (g_wifi.recycle_head + 1) %
866:                                 WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
867:           g_wifi.recycle_count--;
868:           up_irq_restore(flags);
869:           bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
870:           continue;
871:         }
872: 
873:       if (entry->state != WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED ||
874:           !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
875:         {
876:           up_irq_restore(flags);
877:           return;
878:         }
879: 
880:       entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_SENDING;
881:       up_irq_restore(flags);
882:       ret = wifi_send_node_async(BK7258_WIFI_DATA_TX_CHANNEL, &entry->node,
883:                                  wifi_recycle_complete, entry);
884:       if (ret < 0)
885:         {
886:           flags = up_irq_save();
887:           if (entry->state == WIFI_RECYCLE_SENDING)
888:             {
889:               entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
890:             }
891:           up_irq_restore(flags);
892:         }
893: 
894:       return;
895:     }
896: }

898: static void wifi_handle_data(const struct wifi_pending_node *pending)
899: {
900:   const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node = &pending->node;
901:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
902:   bool cp_owned[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
903:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *recycle;
904:   uint32_t address = node->head;
905:   uint8_t packet_added = 0;
906:   unsigned int count;
907:   irqstate_t flags;
908: 
909:   if (!pending->recycle_reserved || node->channel != 2 ||
910:       node->num == 0 || node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
911:     {
912:       return;
913:     }
914: 
915:   recycle = &g_wifi.recycle[pending->recycle_index];
916:   if (pending->generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
917:     {
918:       flags = up_irq_save();
919:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
920:       up_irq_restore(flags);
921:       return;
922:     }
923: 
924:   /* First pass validates the complete list without changing either core's
925:    * ownership.  A malformed list is left untouched.
926:    */
927: 
928:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
929:     {
930:       struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
931:       struct wifi_tx_slot *tx;
932:       uint32_t next;
933:       unsigned int previous;
934: 
935:       if (address == 0)
936:         {
937:           goto invalid;
938:         }
939: 
940:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
941:         {
942:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
943:             {
944:               goto invalid;
945:             }
946:         }
947: 
948:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
949:         {
950:           goto invalid;
951:         }
952: 
953:       addresses[count] = address;
954:       tx = wifi_tx_slot(address);
955:       if (tx != NULL)
956:         {
957:           struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *ap_cpdu =
958:             (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
959: 
960:           if (!tx->active || (ap_cpdu->flags & 1u) == 0)
961:             {
962:               goto invalid;
963:             }
964: 
965:           cp_owned[count] = false;
966:           next = ap_cpdu->next;
967:         }
968:       else
969:         {
970:           if (!wifi_cp_pointer(address, sizeof(cpdu)) ||
971:               !wifi_copy_rx_frame(address, NULL))
972:             {
973:               goto invalid;
974:             }
975: 
976:           memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address, sizeof(cpdu));
977:           cp_owned[count] = true;
978:           next = cpdu.next;
979:         }
980: 
981:       address = next;
982:     }
983: 
984:   if (address != 0)
985:     {
986:       goto invalid;
987:     }
988: 
989:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
990:     {
991:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
992:           g_wifi.packet_count + packet_added < WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE)
993:         {
994:           unsigned int index = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
995:                                WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
996: 
997:           if (wifi_copy_rx_frame(addresses[count], &g_wifi.packets[index]))
998:             {
999:               packet_added++;
1000:             }
1001:         }
1002:     }
1003: 
1004:   flags = up_irq_save();
1005:   if (pending->generation !=
1006:       bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1007:     {
1008:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1009:       up_irq_restore(flags);
1010:       return;
1011:     }
1012: 
1013:   memset(&recycle->node, 0, sizeof(recycle->node));
1014:   recycle->node.channel = 2;
1015:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1016:     {
1017:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1018:           recycle->node.num < BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1019:         {
1020:           wifi_recycle_append(&recycle->node, addresses[count]);
1021:         }
1022:     }
1023: 
1024:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
1025:   recycle->state = recycle->node.num == 0 ? WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD :
1026:                                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
1027:   g_wifi.packet_tail = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1028:                        WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1029:   g_wifi.packet_count += packet_added;
1030:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1031: 
1032:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1033:     {
1034:       if (!cp_owned[count])
1035:         {
1036:           struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = wifi_tx_slot(addresses[count]);
1037: 
1038:           netpkt_free(&g_wifi.lower, tx->packet, NETPKT_TX);
1039:           tx->packet = NULL;
1040:           tx->active = false;
1041:           netdev_lower_txdone(&g_wifi.lower);
1042:         }
1043:     }
1044:   if (packet_added != 0)
1045:     {
1046:       netdev_lower_rxready(&g_wifi.lower);
1047:     }
1048:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1049:   return;
1050: 
1051: invalid:
1052:   flags = up_irq_save();
1053:   recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1054:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1055: }

1058: static int wifi_mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1059:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
1060: {
1061:   struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node node;
1062:   struct wifi_pending_node *pending;
1063:   irqstate_t flags;
1064: 
1065:   (void)ack_flags;
1066:   (void)arg;
1067:   memcpy(&node, message, sizeof(node));
1068:   if (node.num == 0 || node.num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1069:     {
1070:       return -EINVAL;
1071:     }
1072: 
1073:   flags = up_irq_save();
1074:   if (g_wifi.node_count == WIFI_NODE_QUEUE ||
1075:       (node.channel == 2 &&
1076:        g_wifi.recycle_count == WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE))
1077:     {
1078:       up_irq_restore(flags);
1079:       return -EAGAIN;
1080:     }
1081: 
1082:   pending = &g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_tail];
1083:   memset(pending, 0, sizeof(*pending));
1084:   pending->node = node;
1085:   pending->generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
1086:   if (node.channel == 2)
1087:     {
1088:       struct wifi_recycle_entry *entry =
1089:         &g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_tail];
1090: 
1091:       memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));
1092:       entry->generation = pending->generation;
1093:       entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_RESERVED;
1094:       pending->recycle_index = g_wifi.recycle_tail;
1095:       pending->recycle_reserved = true;
1096:       g_wifi.recycle_tail = (g_wifi.recycle_tail + 1) %
1097:                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
1098:       g_wifi.recycle_count++;
1099:     }
1100: 
1101:   g_wifi.node_tail = (g_wifi.node_tail + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1102:   g_wifi.node_count++;
1103:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1104:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1105:   return OK;
1106: }

1108: static void wifi_link_changed(enum bk7258_mb_link_state state, void *arg)
1109: {
1110:   struct wifi_pending_node nodes[WIFI_NODE_QUEUE];
1111:   uint32_t generation;
1112:   bool wake_command = false;
1113:   unsigned int kept = 0;
1114:   unsigned int i;
1115:   irqstate_t flags;
1116: 
1117:   (void)arg;
1118:   if (state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
1119:     {
1120:       return;
1121:     }
1122: 
1123:   wifi_set_carrier(false);
1124:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
1125:   wifi_scan_cache_clear();
1126:   g_wifi.scan_running = false;
1127:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
1128:   flags = up_irq_save();
1129:   if (g_wifi.waiting_id != 0)
1130:     {
1131:       g_wifi.command_result = -ECONNRESET;
1132:       g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
1133:       wake_command = true;
1134:     }
1135:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1136:   if (wake_command)
1137:     {
1138:       nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
1139:     }
1140: 
1141:   generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
1142:   if (generation == g_wifi.reset_generation)
1143:     {
1144:       return;
1145:     }
1146: 
1147:   /* The peer reset proves queued CP pointers are stale, but it does not prove
1148:    * that accepted AP TX storage can be safely reused.  Active TX slots remain
1149:    * quarantined until their exact completion pointer returns.
1150:    */
1151: 
1152:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1153:   flags = up_irq_save();
1154:   g_wifi.reset_generation = generation;
1155:   for (i = 0; i < g_wifi.node_count; i++)
1156:     {
1157:       unsigned int index = (g_wifi.node_head + i) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1158: 
1159:       if (g_wifi.nodes[index].generation == generation)
1160:         {
1161:           nodes[kept++] = g_wifi.nodes[index];
1162:         }
1163:     }
1164:   memcpy(g_wifi.nodes, nodes, kept * sizeof(nodes[0]));
1165:   g_wifi.node_head = 0;
1166:   g_wifi.node_tail = kept % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1167:   g_wifi.node_count = kept;
1168:   g_wifi.packet_head = 0;
1169:   g_wifi.packet_tail = 0;
1170:   g_wifi.packet_count = 0;
1171:   for (i = 0; i < WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE; i++)
1172:     {
1173:       if (g_wifi.recycle[i].state != WIFI_RECYCLE_FREE &&
1174:           g_wifi.recycle[i].generation != generation)
1175:         {
1176:           g_wifi.recycle[i].state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1177:         }
1178:     }
1179:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1180:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1181:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1182: }

1184: static int wifi_worker(int argc, char **argv)
1185: {
1186:   (void)argc;
1187:   (void)argv;
1188:   for (;;)
1189:     {
1190:       struct wifi_pending_node pending;
1191:       irqstate_t flags;
1192: 
1193:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.work_sem,
1194:                                            WIFI_WORK_INTERVAL);
1195:       wifi_flush_recycle();
1196:       for (;;)
1197:         {
1198:           nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1199:           flags = up_irq_save();
1200:           if (g_wifi.node_count == 0)
1201:             {
1202:               up_irq_restore(flags);
1203:               nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1204:               break;
1205:             }
1206: 
1207:           if (g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_head].generation >
1208:               g_wifi.reset_generation)
1209:             {
1210:               up_irq_restore(flags);
1211:               nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1212:               break;
1213:             }
1214: 
1215:           pending = g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_head];
1216:           g_wifi.node_head = (g_wifi.node_head + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1217:           g_wifi.node_count--;
1218:           up_irq_restore(flags);
1219:           if (pending.generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
1220:             {
1221:               if (pending.recycle_reserved)
1222:                 {
1223:                   flags = up_irq_save();
1224:                   g_wifi.recycle[pending.recycle_index].state =
1225:                     WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1226:                   up_irq_restore(flags);
1227:                 }
1228:             }
1229:           else if (pending.node.channel == 0)
1230:             {
1231:               wifi_handle_command_list(&pending.node,
1232:                                        pending.generation);
1233:             }
1234:           else if (pending.node.channel == 2)
1235:             {
1236:               wifi_handle_data(&pending);
1237:             }
1238:           nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1239:           bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1240:         }
1241: 
1242:       wifi_flush_recycle();
1243:     }
1244: 
1245:   return OK;
1246: }

409: static int dispatch_locked(void)
410: {
411:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
412:   struct active_transaction *active;
413:   struct logical_channel *channel;
414:   unsigned int i;
415:   int ret;
416: 
417:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
418: 
419:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
420:     {
421:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
422:         {
423:           continue;

426:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
427:       if (ret < 0)

429:           return ret;

433:     }
434: 
435:   if (g_reset_pending)

438:       if (ret < 0)
439:         {
440:           return ret;

442: 
443:       g_reset_pending = false;
444:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
445:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
446:     }
447: 
448:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
449:     {
450:       return OK;
451:     }
452: 
453:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
454:     {
455:       channel = &g_channels[i];
456:       if (!channel->queued)
457:         {
458:           continue;
459:         }
460: 
461:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
462:         {
463:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
464:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
465:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
466:             {
467:               continue;
468:             }
469: 
470:           active = &epoch->probe;
471:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
472:             {
473:               return -ENOLINK;
474:             }
475:         }
476:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
477:         {
478:           active = &g_active;
479:           if (active->quarantine)
480:             {
481:               return -ENOLINK;
482:             }
483:         }
484:       else
485:         {
486:           return OK;
487:         }
488: 
489:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
490:         {
491:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
492:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
493:                  sizeof(active->message));
494:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
495:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
496:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
497:             g_channel_ids[i]);
498:         }
499: 
500:       active->callback = channel->callback;
501:       active->arg = channel->arg;
502:       active->channel_index = i;
503:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
504:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
505:       if (ret < 0)
506:         {
507:           return ret;
508:         }
509: 
510:       active->busy = true;
511:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
512:         {
513:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
514:             {
515:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
516:             }
517: 
518:           g_probe_attempts++;
519:           g_stats.probes++;
520:         }
521: 
522:       return OK;
523:     }
524: 
525:   return OK;

528: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
529:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
530: {
531:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
532: 
533:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
534:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
535:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
536:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
537:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
538:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
539:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
540: }

542: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
543: {
544:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
545:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
546:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
547: }

549: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
550: {
551:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
552:   struct active_transaction *active;
553:   bool replay;
554:   int result;
555: 
556:   active = busy_probe();
557:   if (active == NULL)
558:     {
559:       active = &g_active;
560:     }
561: 
562:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
563:     {
564:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
565:       return;
566:     }
567: 
568:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
569:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
570:     {
571:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
572: 
573:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
574:       return;
575:     }
576: 
577:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
578:     {
579:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
580:       return;
581:     }
582: 
583:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
584:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
585: 
586:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
587:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
588:     {
589:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
590:     }
591: 
592:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
593:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
594:   if (replay)
595:     {
596:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
597:       unsigned int i;
598: 
599:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
600:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
601:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
602:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
603:        */
604: 
605:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
606:       g_active.quarantine = false;
607:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
608:         {
609:           if (i != replay_index)
610:             {
611:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
612:             }
613:         }
614: 
615:       select_recovery_epoch();
616:       (void)dispatch_locked();
617:       return;
618:     }

620:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);

622:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
623:     {
624:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)

627:           g_recovery_index = 0;
628:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
629:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
630:         }
631:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
632:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
633:         {
634:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
635:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
636:            */
637:         }
638:       else
639:         {
640:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
641:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
642:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
643:         }
644:     }
645: 
646:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
647:            result < 0)
648:     {
649:       begin_abort(result);

655: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
656: {
657:   struct ack_slot *slot;
658:   unsigned int rx_index;
659:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
660:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
661:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
662:   uint8_t state = 0;
663:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
664: 
665:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
666:     {
667:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
668:       if (slot == NULL)
669:         {
670:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
671:           return -EAGAIN;
672:         }
673:     }
674:   else
675:     {
676:       slot = NULL;
677:     }
678: 
679:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
680:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
681:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
682:     {
683:       g_stats.bad_header++;
684:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
685:     }
686:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
687:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
688:     {
689:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
690:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
691:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
692:         {
693:           if (slot != NULL)
694:             {
695:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
696:             }
697: 
698:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
699:           return -EAGAIN;
700:         }
701:       else if (ret < 0)
702:         {
703:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
704:         }
705:     }
706:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
707:     {
708:       g_pwc_rx(message);
709:       ret = OK;
710:     }
711:   else
712:     {
713:       g_stats.unsupported++;
714:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
715:     }
716: 
717:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
718:     {
719:       return OK;
720:     }
721: 
722:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
723:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
724:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
725:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
726:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
727: 
728:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
729:     {
730:       g_probe_requested = true;
731:     }
732: 
733:   (void)dispatch_locked();
734:   return OK;
735: }

737: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
738: {
739:   irqstate_t flags;
740:   uint8_t control;
741: 
742:   flags = up_irq_save();
743:   g_stats.rx++;
744:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
745: 
746:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
747:     {
748:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
749:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
750:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
751:         {
752:           g_stats.bad_header++;
753:         }
754:       else
755:         {
756:           g_stats.resets++;
757:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
758:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
759:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
760:         }
761:     }
762:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
763:     {
764:       handle_ack(message);
765:     }
766:   else
767:     {
768:       int ret = handle_command(message);
769: 
770:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
771:         {
772:           up_irq_restore(flags);
773:           return ret;
774:         }
775:     }
776: 
777:   up_irq_restore(flags);
778:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
779:   return OK;
780: }

824: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
825: {
826:   (void)argc;
827:   (void)argv;

829:   for (;;)
830:     {
831:       struct active_transaction *probe;
832:       irqstate_t flags;
833:       bool request_probe;
834: 
835:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
836:       flags = up_irq_save();
837: 
838:       probe = busy_probe();
839:       if ((g_active.busy &&
840:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
841:           (probe != NULL &&
842:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
843:         {
844:           g_stats.timeout++;
845:           if (probe != NULL)
846:             {
847:               probe->quarantine = true;
848:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
849:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
850:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
851:             }
852:           else
853:             {
854:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
855:             }
856:         }
857: 
858:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
859:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
860:         {
861:           select_recovery_epoch();
862:         }
863: 
864:       (void)dispatch_locked();
865:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
866:         {
867:           g_probe_requested = false;
868:         }
869: 
870:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
871:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
872:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
873:       if (request_probe)
874:         {
875:           g_probe_requested = false;
876:         }
877: 
878:       up_irq_restore(flags);
879: 
880:       if (request_probe)
881:         {
882:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
883:         }
884:     }
885: 
886:   return OK;
887: }

30: #define MBOX_CH0_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x18)
31: #define MBOX_CH2_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x38)
32: #define MBOX_CTRL               MBOX_REG(2)
33: 
34: #define MBOX_CFG_INT_EN         (1u << 8)
35: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN       (1u << 9)
36: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN       (1u << 10)
37: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN      (1u << 11)
38: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS   (1u << 16)
39: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS   (1u << 17)
40: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS  (1u << 18)
41: #define MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS   (MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS | \
42:                                  MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS | \
43:                                  MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS)
44: #define MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK        0x00000fffu
45: 
46: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)
47: 
48: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
49: {
50:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
51:   uint32_t order;
52:   bool used;
53: };
54: 
55: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
56: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
57: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
58: static uint32_t g_processing_order;
59: static bool g_mbox_ready;
60: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
61: 
62: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
63:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");
64: 
65: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
66: {
67:   return getreg32(MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
68: }
69: 
70: static void mbox_clear_errors(void)
71: {
72:   uint32_t config = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_CFG);
73:   uint32_t errors = config & MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
74: 
75:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
76:     {
77:       g_stats.write_error++;
78:     }
79: 
80:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
81:     {
82:       g_stats.read_error++;
83:     }
84: 
85:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
86:     {
87:       g_stats.write_full++;
88:     }
89: 
90:   if (errors != 0)
91:     {
92:       putreg32((config & MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
93:     }
94: }
95: 
96: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
97:                                 uint32_t length)
98: {
99:   if (source != 0)
100:     {
101:       g_stats.bad_source++;
102:       return false;
103:     }
104: 
105:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
106:     {
107:       g_stats.bad_length++;
108:       return false;
109:     }
110: 
111:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
112:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
113:     {
114:       g_stats.bad_address++;
115:       return false;
116:     }
117: 
118:   return true;
119: }
120: 
121: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
122: {
123:   uintptr_t status;
124: 
125:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
126:     {
127:       return -EINVAL;
128:     }
129: 
130:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
131:    * receive FIFO status register.
132:    */
133: 
134:   status = destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
135:            destination == 1 ? MBOX_CH1_STATUS : MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
136:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
137:     {
138:       return -EAGAIN;
139:     }
140: 
141:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
142:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
143:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
144:   return OK;
145: }
146: 
147: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
148: {
149:   unsigned int i;
150: 
151:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
152:     {
153:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
154:         {
155:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
156:         }
157:     }
158: 
159:   return NULL;
160: }
161: 
162: static bool mbox_priority_message(
163:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
164: {
165:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
166: 
167:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
168: }
169: 
170: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
171: {
172:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
173:   unsigned int i;
174: 
175:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
176:     {
177:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
178: 
179:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
180:         {
181:           continue;
182:         }
183: 
184:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
185:         {
186:           oldest = desc;
187:         }
188:     }
189: 
190:   return oldest;
191: }
192: 
193: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
194: {
195:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
196:   int ret;
197: 
198:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
199:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
200:    */
201: 
202:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
203:     {
204:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
205:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
206:       g_processing_order = 0;
207:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
208:         {
209:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
210:           break;
211:         }
212: 
213:       desc->used = false;
214:     }
215: 
216:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
217:     {
218:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
219:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
220:       g_processing_order = 0;
221:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
222:         {
223:           break;
224:         }
225: 
226:       desc->used = false;
227:     }
228: }
229: 
230: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
231: {
232:   (void)irq;
233:   (void)context;
234:   (void)arg;
235: 
236:   mbox_clear_errors();
237: 
238:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
239:     {
240:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
241:       uint32_t address;
242:       uint32_t length;
243:       uint8_t source;
244: 
245:       mbox_process_desc();
246:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
247:       if (desc == NULL)
248:         {
249:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
250:           break;
251:         }
252: 
253:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
254:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
255:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
256:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
257:         {
258:           continue;
259:         }
260: 
261:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
262:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
263:              sizeof(desc->message));
264:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
265:       desc->used = true;
266:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
267:       mbox_process_desc();
268:     }
269: 
270:   mbox_process_desc();
271: 
272:   return OK;
273: }
274: 
275: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
276: {
277:   g_callback = callback;
278: }
279: 
280: void bk7258_mbox_kick_rx(void)
281: {
282:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
283: 
284:   (void)bk7258_mbox_irq(0, NULL, NULL);
285:   up_irq_restore(flags);
286: }
287: 
288: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
289: {
290:   unsigned int i;
291: 
292:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
293:     {
294:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
295:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
296:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
297:         {
298:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
299:         }
300:     }
301: }
302: 
303: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
304: {
305:   irqstate_t flags;
306: 
307:   if (stats == NULL)
308:     {
309:       return;
310:     }
311: 
312:   flags = up_irq_save();
313:   *stats = g_stats;
314:   up_irq_restore(flags);
315: }
316: 
317: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
318: {
319:   int ret;
320: 
321:   if (g_mbox_ready)
322:     {
323:       return OK;
324:     }
325: 
326:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
327:   g_rx_order = 0;
328:   g_processing_order = 0;
329:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
330: 
331:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
332:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
333:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
334:    */
335: 
336:   putreg32(2u | MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
337:            MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
338:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
339:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
340:   mbox_clear_errors();
341: 
342:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
343:   if (ret < 0)
344:     {
345:       return ret;
346:     }
347: 
348:   g_mbox_ready = true;
349:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
350:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
351:   return OK;
352: }

478:     struct openvela_scan_page_response response = {0};
479:     wifi_scan_result_t result = {0};
480:     uint16_t available;
481:     uint16_t count;
482: 
483:     if (msg->len != sizeof(*req)) {
484:         response.status = BK_ERR_PARAM;
485:         return cif_bk_cmd_confirm(msg, (uint8_t *)&response,
486:                                   sizeof(response));
487:     }
488: 
489:     response.page.start = req->start;
490:     if (req->max_records == 0 ||
491:         req->max_records > OPENVELA_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS) {
492:         response.status = BK_ERR_PARAM;
493:         return cif_bk_cmd_confirm(msg, (uint8_t *)&response,
494:                                   sizeof(response));
495:     }
496: 
497:     response.status = bk_wifi_scan_get_result(&result);
498:     if (response.status == BK_OK) {
499:         if (result.ap_num < 0 || result.ap_num > UINT16_MAX ||
500:             (result.ap_num > 0 && result.aps == NULL) ||
501:             req->start > result.ap_num) {
502:             response.status = BK_ERR_PARAM;
503:         } else {
504:             response.page.total = (uint16_t)result.ap_num;
505:             available = response.page.total - req->start;
506:             count = available < req->max_records ? available :
507:                     req->max_records;
508:             response.page.count = (uint8_t)count;
509:             response.page.more = req->start + count < response.page.total;
510: 
511:             for (uint16_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
512:                 const wifi_scan_ap_info_t *ap = &result.aps[req->start + i];
513:                 struct openvela_scan_record *record =
514:                     &response.page.records[i];
515: 
516:                 os_memcpy(record->ssid, ap->ssid, sizeof(record->ssid));
517:                 record->ssid[sizeof(record->ssid) - 1] = '\0';
518:                 os_memcpy(record->bssid, ap->bssid, sizeof(record->bssid));
519:                 record->rssi = (int8_t)ap->rssi;
520:                 record->channel = ap->channel;
521:                 record->security = (uint8_t)ap->security;
522:             }
523:         }
524:     }
525: 
526:     /* The result API owns aps even when the list is empty.  Always release it
527:      * after a successful get, and also release it if a driver returned a
528:      * partially populated result with an error. */
529:     bk_wifi_scan_free_result(&result);
530: 
531:     return cif_bk_cmd_confirm(msg, (uint8_t *)&response, sizeof(response));
532: }

46: /*
47:  * Coexistence netif wire id (2-bit co_hdr.vif_idx). Roles are NOT pinned to a
48:  * fixed LMAC VIF index any more (P2P GO/GC float on vif0/vif1 so the MCC
49:  * channel scheduler can handle them). We therefore key the wire id off the
50:  * (netif type, p2p) role instead of the LMAC index:
51:  *
52:  *   wire 0 = infra STA   (STA-type, !p2p) -> host g_mlan
53:  *   wire 1 = SoftAP      (AP-type,  !p2p) -> host g_uap
54:  *   wire 2 = P2P GO      (AP-type,   p2p) -> host g_p2p_go
55:  *   wire 3 = P2P GC      (STA-type,  p2p) -> host g_p2p_gc
56:  *
57:  * The TX path is symmetric: host tags the wire id, CP maps it back to the
58:  * current LMAC VIF index via cif_wire_to_lmac_vif() (no longer identity).
59:  */
60: static uint8_t cif_vif_to_netif_wire(void *vif)
61: {
62:     netif_if_t t = wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif);
63:     bool p2p = cif_vif_is_p2p(vif);
64: 
65:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_AP) && p2p)
66:         return 2;
67:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_STA) && p2p)
68:         return 3;
69: 
70:     return (uint8_t)t;
71: }
72: 
73: /*
74:  * Reverse of cif_vif_to_netif_wire(): map a host wire id back to the LMAC VIF
75:  * index currently held by that role. Since GO/GC float on vif0/vif1, the old
76:  * identity mapping (wire==index) no longer holds, so look the role up in the
77:  * active VIF table. Falls back to the wire id if no active match is found.
78:  */
79: static uint8_t cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(uint8_t wire)
80: {
81:     netif_if_t want_type;
82:     bool want_p2p;
83: 
84:     switch (wire)
85:     {
86:         case 0: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = false; break;
87:         case 1: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = false; break;
88:         case 2: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = true;  break;
89:         case 3: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = true;  break;
90:         default: return wire;
91:     }
92: 
93:     for (void *vif = mac_vif_mgmt_first_vif(); vif != NULL;
94:          vif = mac_vif_mgmt_next_vif(vif))
95:     {
96:         if ((wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif) == want_type) &&
97:             (cif_vif_is_p2p(vif) == want_p2p))
98:             return wifi_netif_vif_to_vifid(vif);
99:     }
100: 
101:     return wire;
102: }

138: bk_err_t cif_handle_txdata(void *head)
139: {
140:     uint8_t ret = BK_OK;
141:     struct pbuf* pbuf = NULL;
142: 
143:     cpdu_t* cpdu = (cpdu_t*)head;
144:     /* Map the host wire id (0..3) to the LMAC VIF index this role currently
145:      * holds (P2P GO/GC float on vif0/vif1), then tag it with the +0xF offset
146:      * the downstream TX path expects. */
147:     uint8_t vif_id = cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(cpdu->co_hdr.vif_idx) + 0xF;
148:     BK_ASSERT(vif_id < 19);
149: #if CONFIG_BK_RAW_LINK
150:     if (cpdu->co_hdr.special_type == TX_RAW_LINK_TYPE)
151:     {
152:         struct ctrl_cmd_hdr *cpdu = (struct ctrl_cmd_hdr*)head;
153:         uint32_t align_mac_len = CIF_RAW_LINK_MEM_ALIGN_SIZE(RLK_WIFI_MAC_ADDR_LEN);
154: 
155:         if (cpdu->msg_hdr.id == RLK_TX_SEND_EVT)
156:         {
157:              ret = bk_rlk_send((uint8_t *)head + sizeof(struct ctrl_cmd_hdr), 
158:                     (uint8_t *)head + sizeof(struct ctrl_cmd_hdr) + align_mac_len, cpdu->co_hdr.length);
159: 
160:             cpdu->co_hdr.special_type = TX_RLK_FREE_MEM_TYPE;
161:             // Notify AP side to free memory instead of freeing on CP side
162:             cif_send_mem_free_req(head);
163:         }
164: 
165:         return ret;
166:     }
167: #endif
168: 
169:     pbuf = (struct pbuf*)((uint8_t*)head - sizeof(struct pbuf));
170: #if CONFIG_CONTROLLER_RX_DIRECT_PSH
171:     if(cpdu->co_hdr.need_free)
172:     {
173:         cif_stats_ptr->cif_rxc_cnt++;
174:         CIF_LOGV("%s free p:%x,p->ref:%d\r\n",__func__, pbuf,pbuf->ref);
175:         /* AP wdrv_txdata_sender() holds one extra reference while recycling. */
176:         pbuf_free(pbuf);
177:         pbuf_free(pbuf);
178:         return BK_OK;
179:     }
180: #endif
181: 
182:     CIF_STATS_INC(buf_in_txdata);
183:     cif_stats_ptr->cif_tx_cnt++;
184:     CIF_LOGV("%s p:%x next:%x payload%x sizeof:%d\r\n",__func__, pbuf, pbuf->next, pbuf->payload, sizeof(struct pbuf));
185:     CIF_LOGV("%s p:%x,vif_id=%d\r\n",__func__, pbuf,vif_id);
186: 
187: #if CONFIG_CONTROLLER_DEBUG
188:     TRACK_PBUF_ALLOC(pbuf);
189: #endif
190: 
191: #if CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY
192:     /*
193:      * In bridge mode AP-side bridgeif_send_to_port() already pbuf_clone's into
194:      * a PBUF_RAW_TX TX-headroom buffer (see bridgeif.c:1386). Cloning again on
195:      * CP wastes ~1.5KB heap per frame and serializes TX. Skip the second clone
196:      * when bridge is ENABLED and pass the pbuf to bmsg_tx_sender directly.
197:      */
198: #if CONFIG_BRIDGE
199:     if (bk_wifi_get_bridge_state() == BRIDGE_STATE_ENABLED)
200:     {
201:         ret = bmsg_tx_sender(pbuf, vif_id);
202:         if (ret != BK_OK)
203:         {
204:             cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
205:             ret = false;
206:         }
207:         return ret;
208:     }
209: #endif
210: 
211:     struct pbuf* p_copy = pbuf_clone(PBUF_RAW_TX,PBUF_RAM,pbuf);
212: 
213:     if((p_copy == NULL) || (p_copy->payload == NULL))
214:     {
215:         cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
216:         return BK_OK;
217:     }
218: 
219:     memcpy((void*)(p_copy+1),(void*)(pbuf+1),sizeof(cpdu_t));
220:     cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
221:     ret = bmsg_tx_sender(p_copy, vif_id);
222: 
223:     if(ret != BK_OK)
224:     {
225:         //CIF_LOGE("%s %d,p:0x%x\r\n",__func__,__LINE__,p_copy);
226:         pbuf_free(p_copy);
227:     }
228: 
229: #else
230:     ret = bmsg_tx_sender(pbuf, vif_id);
231:     if(ret != BK_OK)
232:     {
233:         cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
234:         ret = false;
235:     }
236: #endif
237:     return ret;
238: }

209: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
210: {
211: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
212: 
213: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
214: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
215: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
216: 
217: 	return ret_code;

220: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
221: {
222: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
223: }

225: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
226: {
227: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
228: 
229: 	while (1)
230: 	{
231: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
232: 		bk_err_t ret;
233: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
234: 
235: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
236: 		{
237: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
238: 			return;
239: 		}
240: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
241: 		ack_sending = 1;
242: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
243: 
244: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
245: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
246: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
247: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
248: 		{
249: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
250: 			ack_sending = 0;
251: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
252: 			return;
253: 		}
254: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
255: 		ack_count--;
256: 		ack_sending = 0;
257: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
258: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
259: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
260: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
261: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
262: 	}
263: }

265: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
266: {
267: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
268: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
269: 
270: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN)
271: 	{
272: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
273: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
274: 		return false;
275: 	}
276: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
277: 	entry->data = *data;
278: 	entry->destination = destination;
279: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
280: 	ack_count++;
281: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
282: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
283: 	return true;
284: }

313: 	}

324: 	return bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)&reset, SELF_CPU,
325: 				    (mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_idx, &chnl_type);
326: }

329: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
330: {
331: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
332: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
333: 	u16 			chnl_type;
334: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
335: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
336: 
337: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
338: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
339: 
340: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
341: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
342: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
343: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
344: #endif
345: 
346: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
347: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
348: 
349: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
350: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
351: 
352: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
353: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
354: 
355: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
356: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
357: 
358: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
359: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
360: 
361: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
362: 
363: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
364: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
365: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
366: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
367: 
368: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
369: 
370: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
371: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
372: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
373: 
374: 	__DMB();
375: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
376: 
377: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
378: 
379: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
380: 
381: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
382: 	{
383: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
384: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
385: 
386: 		return ret_code;
387: 	}
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
392: 
393: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
394: 	{
395: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
396: 	}
397: 
398: 	return BK_OK;
399: }

401: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
402: {
403: 	u8		log_chnl;
404: 	u8		ret_code;
405: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
406: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
407: 
408: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
409: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
410: 
411: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
412: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
413: 	{
414: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
415: 
416: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
417: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
418: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
419: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
420: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
421: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
422: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
423: 		{
424: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
425: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
426: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
427: 			return;
428: 		}
429: 
430: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
431: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
432: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
433: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
434: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
435: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
436: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
437: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
438: 		{
439: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
440: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
441: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
442: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
443: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
444: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
445: 			{
446: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
447: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
448: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
449: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
450: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
451: 			}
452: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
453: 		}
454: 		else
455: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
456: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
457: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
458: 		return;
459: 	}
460: 
461: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
462: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
463: 
464: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
465: 
466: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
467: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
468: 		return;
469: 	}
470: 
471: 
472: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
473: 	{
474: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
475: 		return;
476: 	}
477: 
478: 
479: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
480: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
481: 		return;
482: 	}
483: 
484: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
485: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
486: 
487: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
488: 	{
489: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
490: 		return;
491: 	}
492: 
493: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
494: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
495: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
496: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
497: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
498: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
499: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
500: 	{
501: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
502: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
503: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
504: 		return;
505: 	}
506: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
507: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
508: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
509: 
510: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
511: 
512: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
513: 	{
514: 		/* clear following header members. */
515: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
516: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
517: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
518: 
519: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
520: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
521: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
522: 	} else {
523: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
524: 	}
525: 
526: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
527: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
528: 	{
529: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
530: 		return;
531: 	}
532: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
533: 	{
534: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
535: 			break;
536: 	}
537: 
538: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
539: 	{
540: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
541: 		return;
542: 	}
543: 
544: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
545: 
546: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
547: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
548: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
549: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
550: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
551: 
552: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
553: 
554: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
555: 	{
556: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
557: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
558: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
559: 	}
560: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
561: 
562: 	return;
563: 
564: }

566: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
567: {
568: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
569: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
570: 
571: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
572: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
573: 
574: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
575: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
576: 
577: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
578: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
579: 
580: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
581: 
582: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
583: 		return;
584: 
585: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
586: 		return;
587: 
588: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
589: 		return;
590: 
591: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
592: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
593: 
594: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
595: 
596: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
597: 	{
598: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
599: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
600: 
601: 		return;
602: 	}
603: 
604: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
605: 	{
606: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
607: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
608: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
609: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
610: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
611: 
612: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
613: 
614: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
615: 	}
616: 	else
617: 	{
618: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
619: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
620: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
621: 	}
622: 
623: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
624: 	{
625: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
626: 		return;
627: 	}
628: 
629: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
630: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
631: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
632: 
633: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
634: 	{
635: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
636: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
637: 		return;
638: 	}
639: 	return;
640: }

642: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
643: {
644: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
645: 
646: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
647: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
648: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
649: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
650: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
651: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
652: 
653: 	/*
654: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
655: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
656: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
657: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
658: 	 */
659: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
660: 	{
661: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
662: 	}
663: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
664: 	{
665: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
666: 	}
667: }

669: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
670: {
671: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
672: 
673: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
674: 
675: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
676: 
677: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
678: 
679: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
680: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
681: 
682: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
683: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
684: 
685: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
686: 
687: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
688: 	{
689: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
690: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
691: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
692: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
693: 
694: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
695: 
696: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
697: 		{
698: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
699: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
700: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
701: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
702: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
703: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
704: 
705: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
706: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
707: 			}
708: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
709: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
710: 			return ret_code;
711: 		}
712: 	}
713: 
714: 	return BK_OK;
715: }
